question: Where should Puruṣa be visualized in relation to Īśāna, Sakala, head, and face?
premises: Īśāna and Sakala are named as loci.
The head and face are named as bodily loci.
Puruṣa is the object of visualization.
inference: One should visualize Puruṣa in Īśāna and Sakala, on the head and on the face.
uncertainties: The precise mapping among the four loci is compressed and open to interpretation.
plain_english: One should visualize Puruṣa in Īśāna and Sakala, on the head and on the face.
